compute_mpjpe: compute the mean per-joint position error between predicted and ground truth 3D pose positions
compute_mpjre: compute the mean per-joint rotation error between predicted and ground truth joint angles with pi wrapping
compute_mpjve: compute the mean per-joint velocity error between predicted and ground truth pose velocities scaled by fps
compute_jitter: compute the predicted or ground truth position jitter using a fourth-order finite difference filter scaled by fps cubed
get_metric_function: look up and return a metric function by name from the metric_funcs_dict registry
